items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: That was the first job I had.

ctx.x: So he had the band that you came to work with.
He had a little... He had five or six pieces. What did he have? Two saxophones, trumpet, piano and drums. That was the first job I had.
So you came to D.C. in February. When did you get that job?
